column1: # The system calls `bingsu prompt` may make once the Linux seccomp filter
# is on (crates/bingsu/src/sandbox.rs RULES, with the argument checks named
# in `why`), one row each; any other call fails with EPERM and has no
# effect. N4 option 3 (2026-10-17) adds only held-fd reads/closes and
# CLOCK_BOOTTIME observations; all pathname and fd-fact calls precede the filter.
# `syscall` is the kernel name (`-` for a constant row),
# `libc` the function or constant the adapter (crates/bingsu/src/prompt.rs)
# names for it (`-` for std, kernel, or the pinned held-fd executor).
# Kept in step by scripts/check_cli_prompt_forbid.py (header, columns,
# the adapter's libc names), the strace tests (the rows with both columns
# equal the traced write, process and network calls; everything traced
# after the filter is a row) and the probe test in sandbox.rs (each
# function row makes its row's syscall). A task that adds a call adds its
# row here in the same pull request.

column3: why
the record; fd 1 only (spec section 6 rule 3)
no atexit handlers (spec section 4)
the retry condition of write
glibc's _exit falls back to it; ends the calling thread only
std's allocator (glibc malloc) growing the heap
the allocator for large blocks; anonymous and private only, never PROT_EXEC
the allocator freeing large blocks
the allocator growing a large block (realloc)
the allocator returning freed memory
allocators and guard pages; never PROT_EXEC
std's locks and one-time init (the panic hook, Once)
allocators and hash seeds (jemalloc, mimalloc); randomness only
glibc's restartable sequences; per-thread CPU id
allocators' spin locks
glibc thread setup; futex list of this thread
return from any signal handler (kernel)
the signal mask of this thread (abort, unwinders)
this process's own signal handlers; std's fault handler resets SIGSEGV with it, and without it a fault loops forever
std's stack overflow guard
N4: sequential reads of pre-filter held fds; lengths chosen by core
N4: release pre-filter held fds exactly once (OwnedFd)
N4: CLOCK_BOOTTIME only; libc vDSO fallback syscall
